args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (error rate 0.18). Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent version that was healthy in production. Rollback completed across us-east, us-west, and eu-west.

trace.final:
I rolled back checkout-api and opened an incident.

**What I did:**
1. Checked status: `checkout-api` was running `v2.3.1` in all regions, unhealthy with a 0.18 error rate.
2. Reviewed deployment history: `v2.3.0` was the most recent healthy production release (the only later production entry, `v2.3.1`, was unhealthy).
3. Rolled back to `v2.3.0` across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) — status `rolled_out`.
4. Opened a SEV2 incident (`INC-0001`) describing the failure and the rollback, which paged on-call.
